reason: The original pools passed ordered-tensor checks but failed global exact graph-identity checks; no refreshed ENPDA retrieval predictions were produced on those pools.
exclusion: Every node/edge-label-preserving isomorphism class in the union of all three released MCES training banks, which contains every ENPDA reference/student training/validation graph and the supervised retrieval baselines' training/validation graphs.
identity: WL4 is only a prefilter. Ordered JSON tensor digests cache repeated inputs; exact VF2 confirms identity. First-seen representative digests name equivalence classes.
pool_construction: Keep the existing deterministic size-controlled parent selection, 0.65 WL cosine + 0.35 size hardness, edit recipes and 20x500 scope; replace ordered-tensor identities by exact labeled graph identities before selecting any query, parent or derived candidate.

oracle.timeouts: Keep unresolved metric intervals; never silently impute negatives.

evaluation.enpda: Unchanged frozen graph-disjoint checkpoint matched to pool seed, original Fast search budget
evaluation.neural_baselines: Reuse their previously trained supervised checkpoints and evaluate all methods on the same rebuilt pools; no retrieval test training.
